name: agent-review-04-did-you-create-a-link
goal: The person asks what happened. The answer leads with who did what, and nothing new is created.

seed.requires: One test link on the form, minted by a confirmed plan in scenario 2.

assistantMust: lead with who did what: the person confirmed a plan, and the step ran
never say I created, I minted or I made
not propose anything, because the question is a question
say the address was shown once and cannot be read back

notes: A reply that corrects the record before it answers the question fails this scenario even when every fact in it is right.
